prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical cinematic fantasy portrait of Yuna from Final Fantasy X, rendered as a realistic young woman with soft fair skin, a delicate oval face, subtle natural makeup, glossy lips, and heterochromia: one green eye and one vivid blue eye. She has short tousled chestnut-brown bob hair with side-swept bangs, windblown strands, and fine rim lighting along the hair. Pose her close to the camera in a dramatic three-quarter view, looking directly at the viewer with a calm, wistful expression, while extending one arm and open hand toward the lens so the hand is large, softly blurred, and foreshortened in the foreground. Dress her in an elegant summoner-inspired outfit: a white sleeveless wrap-style kimono top over a black inner garment, translucent flowing pale lavender sleeves, a floral orange obi belt, a small blue pendant necklace, and one dangling beaded earring with blue, purple, and gold accents. The background is a magical night scene filled with deep blue and violet bokeh, glowing particles, lens flares, and drifting pink cherry blossom petals, with warm golden light from the upper left and cool blue-purple backlight from the right. Use shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, ultra-real skin texture, painterly realism, soft volumetric glow, detailed fabric folds, and a dreamy emotional atmosphere. Vertical 9:16 composition, face sharp and centered in the upper half, outstretched hand occupying the lower left foreground, no extra characters, no visible watermark or text.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级超写实竖版奇幻肖像，主角为 《最终幻想 X》中的 Yuna，采用低角度近景视角，她的一只手伸向观众，前景呈现强烈的虚化效果。她是一位年轻女性，五官柔和精致，留着齐肩凌乱的 栗棕色头发，侧分刘海，肤色明亮，拥有异色瞳，左眼为 绿色，右眼为 蓝色。她表情平静、深情且充满吸引力，直视镜头。她身穿白色飘逸的和服式上衣，内搭黑色内衬，系着橙色花卉腰带，佩戴蓝色宝石项链，以及一只垂坠的串珠耳环，珠子呈蓝色、紫色和金色。场景充满梦幻的紫蓝色夜间灯光、来自左上方的温暖轮廓光、柔和的镜头光晕、发光粒子，以及恰好 20 片处于不同深度的飘落粉色樱花花瓣。使用浅景深效果：伸出的手在下方前景中显得较大且柔和模糊，而面部则清晰对焦。背景是深靛色、紫罗兰色和电光蓝组成的空灵散景，具有浪漫的奇幻游戏写实感，皮肤和头发细节丰富，具有戏剧性的体积光，85mm 肖像镜头感，9:16 竖版构图。在左下角添加一个细微的草书签名，并在右侧中心边缘附近添加一个淡淡的小型社交媒体水印，但需保持不显眼。
